Devices_ProtocolHint: Hikvision (ISAPI) uses HTTP and RTSP video. Hikvision SDK uses port 8000 like iVMS-4200 and needs the HCNetSDK library (Settings → General). ONVIF is the standard protocol of other manufacturers' cameras; recording playback is available only for Hikvision devices.
General_SdkHint: The "Hikvision SDK" protocol talks to devices on port 8000, like iVMS-4200. It needs Hikvision's Device Network SDK (HCNetSDK), which is not included: download it from hikvision.com (Support → Download → SDK) and select its library folder (the one with HCNetSDK.dll / libhcnetsdk.so and the HCNetSDKCom folder).
General_SdkFolderWatermark: Empty = "hcnetsdk" folder next to the application
General_SdkFound: Library found. It is loaded when a device with the Hikvision SDK protocol is used.
General_SdkRestart: Restart the application to use the library from the new folder.
General_SdkUnsupported: Hikvision provides the SDK library only for Windows and Linux; on this system use the Hikvision (ISAPI) protocol.
